title: Gravity Playground
description: The catalog, dropped: chips of parts fall, bounce, pile and can be thrown across the stage.
usage: Every chip is a part name with a small physics body: gravity, wall bounces, cheap collisions, and a pointer that can grab and fling. It is a toy — the kind a conference booth runs on a big screen. Put it anywhere the brand can afford to be caught playing.
a11y: Labeled as a toy: the chips are inert text to assistive technology (the same names exist in the Components index, in order). Under prefers-reduced-motion the chips rest in a neat pile at the floor — gravity, but polite.
